sentences.en: My son tried to become a teller of funny stories.
sentences.zh: 我儿子试图成为一个讲笑话的人。

sentences.en: My son tried to become a rakugo story teller.
sentences.zh: 我儿子试图成为一名落语表演者。

sentences.en: According to the fortune teller, I was supposedly a prince in another life.
sentences.zh: 根据算命先生的说法，在我的上一世，我是位王子。

senses.zh: (银行)出纳员 - (投票时的)计票员 - 讲故事等的人, 讲述者 Teller特勒(姓氏)
